Not all who sample are lost.

```{=html}
<p id="lost-page-passage">P.P.P.S. We asked Butterbur to forward this page. Given the 404, most of the posterior mass now lies behind the bar at the Prancing Pony.</p>
<template id="lost-page-alternatives">
  <p>The previous page ended with “they are coming.” This one returns a 404. We are beginning to doubt that the pages went missing at random.</p>
  <p>We sent four chains down different paths to find your page. All four ended up at this 404. Tom Bombadil says they do that at the Withywindle, too.</p>
  <p>Gandalf got into Moria by reading the door more carefully. We have now read your URL twice. The posterior still favours “there is no door.”</p>
</template>
<script>
  (() => {
    const passage = document.getElementById("lost-page-passage");
    const alternatives = document.getElementById("lost-page-alternatives").content.children;
    const passages = [passage, ...alternatives];
    passage.textContent = passages[Math.floor(Math.random() * passages.length)].textContent;
  })();
</script>
```
